official.deadline_note: The AES page publishes no fixed deadline. Pre-admission follows Tsinghua's international graduate application window, generally September to February of the following year, with each department setting its own deadline and application batches in the 'Remarks of Application' of the program catalog.
official.application_cycle: 2026 intake round has closed; applications run September to February for the following year's autumn enrollment
official.status_note: The Tsinghua AES page is the standing program description (last updated February 2024) with no open round announced; the 2026 intake listed in the catalogue has closed, and the next round is expected to follow the September-February application window.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Tsinghua's AES page lists 'Tuition fees' first under Scholarship Coverage.
official.funding_period: per month (Master's; Doctoral: 3,500 CNY per month)
benefits: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
eligibility: Citizens of countries other than the PRC who are committed to the nuclear industry for the benefit of the society and in good health

Holders of a Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in such majors as nuclear engineering, nuclear technology applications, mechanics, energy, chemical engineering and physics with strong capability of scientific research
Proficiency in English (spoken, written and reading), with valid certificate of language proficiency
Under the age of 35 when applying for a Master's program; under the age of 40 when applying for a doctoral program
Those with work experience in nuclear or related fields will be given priority consideration
requirements: Pre-admission at Tsinghua with a department recommendation before the scholarship stage
Valid certificate of English language proficiency
Application completed on the Tsinghua online application system with the RMB 800 application fee paid at submission
Applicants must meet Tsinghua's general qualifications for international graduate students (nationality, degree and health requirements)
documents: Personal statement completed in the application system; PhD applicants also upload a brief research experience or research plan
Degree certificate and degree authentication (CSCSE authentication for degrees from overseas universities)
Academic transcript (undergraduate for Master's applicants; both graduate and undergraduate for Doctoral applicants; GPA certification if the transcript does not show the total GPA)
Two academic recommendation letters from scholars holding the title of associate professor or higher, or senior professionals in a related field
Passport bio page (personal ordinary-type passport) and the required nationality status documentation
selection_criteria: Pre-admission to the listed graduate programs and a department recommendation
Assessed and decided by the China Atomic Energy Authority, the Ministry of Education of the PRC and the China Scholarship Council
Priority consideration for applicants with work experience in nuclear or related fields
coverage: Free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy
application_method: Pre-admission: apply online at https://yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin for the listed graduate programs and reach the department's requirements for a recommendation
Complete the System Application: fill in and submit information via the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System (http://studyinchina.csc.edu.cn) once informed by the pre-admitted department

Assessment: applications are reviewed by the university, then assessed and decided by CAEA, MOE and the China Scholarship Council; recipients are notified by the university via email before July 31 of the year of admission
official.application_route: Apply for pre-admission on the Tsinghua application system, secure a department recommendation, then complete the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System application at studyinchina.csc.edu.cn
official.citizenship_residency: Open to citizens of countries other than the PRC (non-Chinese citizens committed to the nuclear industry)
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is for international (non-Chinese) applicants from developing countries
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Applicants must apply to the listed nuclear-related programs at the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology: Nuclear Science and Technology; Physics; Energy and Power Engineering (nuclear energy science and engineering, nuclear fuel cycle and materials, nuclear technology and applications, radiation and environment protection, medical physics and engineering, fission energy science and engineering, nuclear fusion and plasma physics, isotope separation/application and mechanical engineering, particle and nuclear physics experiment)
official.research_requirement: Strong capability of scientific research is required; PhD applicants must upload a brief research experience or research plan with the application
official.duration: Master's degree: 2-3 years; Doctoral degree: 3-4 years
official.description: The Atomic Energy Scholarship (AES) Program of China is jointly initiated by the China Atomic Energy Authority (CAEA) and the Ministry of Education of the PRC to foster outstanding young talent working in the field of peaceful use of nuclear energy from developing countries. At Tsinghua, recipients study the listed nuclear-related graduate programs at the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology, with tuition fees, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, stipend and comprehensive medical insurance covered.
official.program_type: Government full scholarship for graduate study, administered through the Chinese Government Scholarship system
official.english_requirement: Proficiency in English (spoken, written and reading), with valid certificate of language proficiency

not_confirmed: funding_amount as printed on Tsinghua's own AES page - the page lists coverage categories only; the CNY 3,000/3,500 monthly stipend figures come from the Chinese Government Scholarship full-scholarship standard published on official AES host-university pages (XJTU, SJTU) and official PRC government channels
the number of AES awards available at Tsinghua per cycle
verification.notes: Coverage categories, duration, eligibility, documents and the two-step application route verified on Tsinghua's own AES page and its 2026/2027 international graduate guides; stipend figures cross-checked against official AES pages of other CAEA/MOE-accredited universities and the CGS full-scholarship coverage published by PRC government channels, since Tsinghua's page prints no figures.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a niche, state-sponsored route into Tsinghua's nuclear programs for non-Chinese nationals: you must first win a pre-admission recommendation from the Department of Engineering Physics or the Institute of Nuclear and New Energy Technology, then confirm the award through the Chinese Government Scholarship system, with the final decision resting with CAEA, the Ministry of Education and the CSC rather than with the university alone. The 2026 round has closed, so plan for the next September-February window and watch each department's own deadline, which is the date that actually binds you. The package covers tuition, dormitory or an accommodation subsidy, a monthly living stipend and medical insurance, but you should budget separately for airfare, the non-refundable RMB 800 application fee and any off-campus housing.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Recent graduates and early-career professionals from developing countries with nuclear-sector degrees or work experience seeking a funded Master's or PhD at Tsinghua.
application_readiness_checklist: Start CSCSE authentication of any overseas degree early - it is required at application for graduates and before registration for final-year students
Line up two recommendation letters from associate professors or senior professionals before the department deadline, since referees submit through the online system
Obtain a valid English proficiency certificate (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent) in time for the application

Email the relevant department office (gwyjs@tsinghua.edu.cn for the Department of Engineering Physics, hyyjyk@tsinghua.edu.cn for INET) to confirm the current pre-admission deadline and whether your research direction matches an available supervisor
Prepare colour scans made on a flatbed scanner - phone photos, camera shots and scans of copies are rejected
common_rejection_risks: Missing the department's own pre-admission deadline, which is separate from and earlier than any university-level date
Applying to a program outside the AES list - only the specified nuclear majors at the Department of Engineering Physics and INET qualify

Failing the nationality documentation rules, especially the conditions for former Chinese nationals or applicants born to Chinese-citizen parents, with no supplementary documents accepted after the deadline
Exceeding the age limits at application (35 for Master's, 40 for Doctoral)
Weak or missing English evidence - a valid language certificate is mandatory, not an optional extra
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Round-trip airfare, the RMB 800 non-refundable application fee, visa and physical-examination costs, off-campus accommodation if you do not secure an on-campus dormitory room, and any living costs that exceed the monthly stipend
document_audit: Colour flatbed scans only - mobile-phone or camera images and scans of copies are not accepted
Every document must be in Chinese or English, or accompanied by a notarised translation
If your transcript does not display a total GPA, a separate GPA certification from your university is required
Degree authentication must come from CSCSE (overseas degrees) or CHSI (Chinese mainland degrees) - self-certified translations do not count
Nationality and identity documents cannot be supplemented after the application deadline
alerts: The award decision is multi-agency (CAEA, MOE, CSC) - even a Tsinghua pre-admission does not guarantee the scholarship
Recipients are notified by email before July 31 of the admission year, leaving a tight window for visa, travel and September registration

Tsinghua's AES page prints no stipend figure; the amount follows the Chinese Government Scholarship full-scholarship standard (CNY 3,000/month for Master's, CNY 3,500/month for Doctoral), so confirm the current rate with the department before relying on it
The application fee is never refundable and is not covered by the scholarship
On-campus housing is first come, first served - failing to book a room means arranging and funding your own off-campus accommodation
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the Tsinghua application system at yzbm.tsinghua.edu.cn/intlLogin, upload documents and pay the RMB 800 fee before the department's pre-admission deadline; after receiving a pre-admission recommendation, submit the Chinese Government Scholarship application at studyinchina.csc.edu.cn and await the multi-agency decision by email.
